7 In the past the time, in minutes, taken for a particular rail journey has been found to have mean 20.5
and standard deviation 1.2. Some new railway signals are installed. In order to test whether the mean
time has decreased, a random sample of 100 times for this journey are noted. The sample mean is
found to be 20.3 minutes. You should assume that the standard deviation is unchanged.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
Carry out a significance test, at the 4% level, of whether the population mean time has decreased.

Later another significance test of the same hypotheses, using another random sample of size 100, is
carried out at the 4% level.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Given that the population mean is now 20.1, find the probability of a Type II error.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
State what is meant by a Type II error in this context.
